flags.why: Passing on news or information is a neutral everyday use of truyền, so the formal warning is misleading.
Việc làm commonly means an act or deed, which the employment gloss does not cover.
flags.fix: Add noun: act; deed, with example: Đó là một việc làm tốt. = That is a good deed.

flags.why: Thú meaning pleasant or enjoyable occurs in ordinary conversation, as illustrated by the [dictionary examples](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-th%C3%BA), and is not restricted to literary language.
In this example, tách represents the cracking sound while nổ expresses the popping action, as the [dictionary definition](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-t%C3%A1ch) confirms.
flags.fix: Merge with sense 4: of a light snapping or cracking sound.

flags.why: The entry omits the everyday sense of leaning close or towards something, documented in [ghé vào tai nói thầm](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-gh%C3%A9).
flags.fix: Add verb: to lean close; to lean towards, with example: Cô ấy ghé sát tai tôi nói nhỏ. = She leaned close to my ear and whispered.

flags.why: Tội lỗi does not have an established clothing sense meaning cheap-looking or tacky.
flags.fix: Delete this sense and its example.

flags.why: Chảy describing fabric stretching or sagging is an ordinary current use, also recorded without a rarity warning in the [dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-ch%E1%BA%A3y).
